text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- U.S. launches campaign of lies against Iraq.
- Foreign minister responds to U.S. lies on an Iraqi bid to retake Kuwait.
- Pilgrims in Najaf and Karbala call for victory to President Saddam Hussein.
- French MP criticises UNSCOM, the U.N. commission disarming Iraq under the 1991 Gulf War ceasefire terms.
- Clinton and Arab countries with peace deals with Israel are to meet soon.
- Iraqi engineers reconstruct cement factory in Karbala.
- Call for the freeing of Iraqi assets abroad.
- Editorial lambasts U.S. for allegations on power struggle in Baghdad.
